clips.title: The story
paras: Outside fallen Dun Modr, Longbraid the Grim keeps watch over the northern Wetlands. He mourns his brother and the loss of the Thandol Span, while leading the surviving dwarves against the Dark Iron clan.

Longbraid the Grim rallies the dwarven garrison near the bridge to the Arathi Highlands. The Dark Iron clan seized Dun Modr in a sudden assault that devastated the defenders. Longbraid's brother died during the siege of the Thandol Span. Grief and hatred keep Longbraid at the northern boundary, where he directs travelers and surviving mountaineers in strikes against the Dark Iron advance.

Longbraid also directs dwarven operations across the Wetlands. He sent soldiers to escort Prospector Whelgar into the marshlands and works to reclaim Dun Modr's lost fortifications. He vows retribution against the Dark Iron saboteurs.
